title: Oscar and the Glasshouse
author: Ulyana Vane
blurb: Ivo Pemberton, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
